title.zh: 【Aptos 主网上线加密内存池，交易内容在区块最终确认前保持加密】
title.en: 【Aptos 主网上线加密内存池，交易内容在区块最终确认前保持加密】

current_state.zh: Aptos launched an encrypted mempool on mainnet under AIP-144, letting users opt per-transaction to have calldata encrypted client-side and only collectively decrypted by validators once a block is finalized, with Petra wallet and Decibel already adopting it.
current_state.en: Aptos launched an encrypted mempool on mainnet under AIP-144, letting users opt per-transaction to have calldata encrypted client-side and only collectively decrypted by validators once a block is finalized, with Petra wallet and Decibel already adopting it.
